faqs.question: How long does a typical Content Marketing engagement take?
faqs.answer: Strategy and operating rhythm usually stand up in 3–6 weeks. Compounding traffic and pipeline effects build over subsequent quarters.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We fit your CMS, editorial calendar, design system, and SME interview process.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: Organic conversions, assisted pipeline, topic authority growth, engagement quality, and content production velocity.

faqs.question: Blog posts only or full funnel content?
faqs.answer: Full funnel — landing narratives, comparison pages, case studies, email nurture, and distribution — not random blogging.

faqs.question: Do you need subject-matter interviews?
faqs.answer: Ideally yes. Expert input is how we keep content differentiated and cite-worthy for search and AI answers.

faqs.question: Can you match our brand voice?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build a short voice guide from your best assets and enforce it across drafts and edits.

faqs.question: How do you pick topics?
faqs.answer: Revenue intent first: demand from customers/sales, keyword opportunity, and competitive gaps — scored together.

faqs.question: Design and visuals included?
faqs.answer: Basic editorial visuals are included; larger design systems or video can be scoped with our creative studio.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: We audit existing content, define pillars, and ship a 90-day calendar with owners and distribution plan.

faqs.question: Who writes and edits?
faqs.answer: Strategist + writers/editors. You approve key pieces; we keep a predictable review SLA.
